value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the canonical cubic nonplanar graph. Its unordered three-particle space is the first setting admitting three-dimensional cubical cells, hence dimension reduction is nontrivial. The exact 25-dimensional free H2 and two-dimensional spine resolve a natural finite invariant not determined by known H1 or two-particle formulas. The integral answer distinguishes the remaining H1 order-two torsion from degree-two freeness; it is useful for comparison across nonplanar symmetric graph braid spaces, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
